heading_en: Transitional Measures for Capital Enhancement Measures by Public Institutions
summary_ja: 公的機関による資本増強で適用日前に発行された資本調達手段のうち旧告示の基本的項目・補完的項目に該当するものを、平成30年3月31日まで新告示の基礎項目に算入できる。
summary_en: Allows capital instruments issued before the Application Date through public capital injections to be counted in CET1 or Tier 2 basic items until March 31, 2018, depending on whether they were Tier 1-type or Supplementary Items under the Former Public Notice.
paragraphs: With respect to the amount of capital instruments issued before the Application Date through measures for capital enhancement by public institutions that fall under the basic items in the formula of Article 3 of the Former Public Notice, until March 31, 2018, that amount may be included in the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (i) of the Public Notice.

With respect to the amount of capital instruments issued before the Application Date through measures for capital enhancement by public institutions that fall under the supplementary items in the formula of Article 3 of the Former Public Notice (for those that have a redemption date and for which the period remaining until that redemption date has become five years or less, the amount obtained by multiplying the amount recorded on the consolidated balance sheet by the ratio obtained by dividing the number of days in the period from the calculation reference date to that redemption date by the number of days in the period from the day on which the period remaining until that redemption date became five years to that redemption date), until March 31, 2018, that amount may be included in the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) of the Public Notice.
